metadata.title: Two-Tier Presentation Layer and Response Modes (Lite)
metadata.description: Builds, lints and renders the Tier 1 quick-glance card for the current host and structures every answer in one of the seven response modes, then hands off to the unchanged Tier 2 deliverable. Lite cards carry counts of checks passed, never a weighted score.
metadata.author: BIQDADDY

configuration.purpose: Turn a finished run into a clear card in chat and point to the complete deliverable, on any AI host, without inventing a single number.

inputs.deliverable: The Tier 2 file the calling unit just wrote (report-lite HTML, an audit Markdown, a deploy file) or, for plain questions, the answer content.
inputs.host: One of claude-desktop, cowork, artifact, chatgpt, gemini, cursor, vscode, preview, github, obsidian, claude-code, cli, terminal, email. Passed by the caller or read from RAINMOJO_PRESENT_TARGET.
inputs.mode: quick_fact, howto, comparison, troubleshoot, audit, deployable. The caller sets it from the request; the primary deliverable decides when a request mixes modes.

rules: Copy every value from the deliverable: counts of checks passed, platform states, competitor citation counts, query matrix rows. Never re-estimate.
Lite edition: omit the score block entirely. dimensions[].value is the number of checks passed and dimensions[].max the number of checks run; platforms[].score is null.
A value the run could not measure is null or unverifiable and its reason goes to transparency.could_not_verify.
Keep text short: summary 2 to 3 sentences, key_risk body under 90 words, action body under 40 words, 3 to 4 actions, at most 3 next steps.
Language follows meta.lang from the client profile; the card and the deliverable use the same language.
No emoji, no glyph in JSON text, no em dash, no pipe (deployables and diff text may contain pipes the client site already uses).
handoff.tier2_path is the deliverable path under work/{domain}/ or the client-confined path returned by client_workspace.py route; handoff.tier2_url only when an artifact was published.
next_steps prompts are exact slash commands of this plugin, e.g. /rainmojo-so-lite:aiso-platform-lite {domain}.
step_1_build_summary.builder: python {PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/rainmojo-so-lite/scripts/build_summary.py --agent {agent_json} --page {page_json} --robots {robots_json} --checklist {checklist_json} --sampling {sampling_json} --client {client} --domain {domain} --lang {lang} --skill {skillkey} --tier2 {tier2_target} --summary "{two or three sentences}" --out {summary_target}. Absent inputs simply leave their blocks out; the builder never estimates.

step_2_lint.rule: Any FAIL line blocks the render. Fix the JSON, never the lint.

ladder.show: Pass the fragment to the host's inline widget tool. Write the one-sentence summary in the reply text as well; the widget holds the visual.
Publish as an artifact or canvas page, or write the card file next to the deliverable and open it in the preview pane.
Emit the fenced mermaid block for workflow or decision questions only, and only where the host renders mermaid; pair it with the Markdown card for counts.
Emit the fenced text block with the pure ASCII tree when the host shows mermaid as raw code or is a plain console.
Emit the Markdown as the reply body. ASCII bars [#####-----] and text pills are allowed here only.

step_3_render.fallback: If a rung fails to render, drop exactly one rung and retry; never leave the user without a card.

step_4_handoff.rule: The last thing the user sees is the hand-off line naming the Tier 2 file and the 2 to 3 next steps. The Tier 2 deliverable is never truncated, summarised in place, or replaced by the card.

hard_rules.no_emoji: No emoji or pictograph on any surface; presentation_instruction_gate.py and present.py --lint reject them.
hard_rules.glyphs: Typographic glyphs only in chat and Markdown; the HTML card uses inline SVG icons.
hard_rules.status_colours: Semantic status tokens never follow the brand; only --brand-primary, --brand-accent, --brand-accent-ink change per client.
hard_rules.honesty: Unmeasured means could not verify. A card that shows a value the deliverable does not carry is a defect.
hard_rules.no_score: Lite edition: no score block, no percentage, no band. Counts of checks passed only.

output.summary: {domain}_{skillkey}_{YYYY-MM-DD}_summary.json next to the deliverable (work/{domain}/04-reports/ or the report-data route of a client workspace)
output.card_file: {domain}_{skillkey}_{YYYY-MM-DD}_card.html in the same folder, only when the host needs a file
